Fully playable with the Revolver.

Buy the "Supporter Pack DLC" to support my work and get more weapons to play with: Machine Gun, Bow, Carbine and Coach Gun.

::: STORY :::

The outlaws aren't too happy about you jailing their leader, Sheriff.

They're all over town. Grab your six-shooter and clear them out.

::: STRAIGHTFORWARD NON-STOP ACTION :::

Gunfight your way through procedurally generated Wild West towns.

Get rid of all outlaws or die trying.

::: CUSTOMIZE GAMEPLAY MECHANICS :::

There is a bunch of options that modify different aspects of how the game mechanics work.

This allows you to shape the difficulty to suit your playstyle and skill level.

Do you want the gunfights to require hardcore skill or just be casual?

Here are some examples:

  • What reaction time should outlaws have, and how well do they aim?

  • Do you want projectiles to be affected by gravity? Should damage account for velocity?

  • Choose the amount of health you have and if it regenerates after a specified time.

  • Should reloading be realistic, fast, or not even needed?

  • ...
